title: Ellaz fight arena file
description: Where a match happens. `view` and `sim` are VIEW PIXELS - compile.ts turns every one of them into FP (1/256 px) and gravity into FP per tick squared, so the sim never divides. `scale` is the rational the sprite frame pixels are drawn at (1/5 here, and 0.2 is not representable in binary floating point, which is why it is a pair and not a number). `art` is the ONLY loose object in this directory: the core never opens it, a cell draws from it, and pinning its shape here would mean editing a schema every time somebody adds a stripe.

scale.description: frame pixels -> view pixels, as num/den

sim.description: everything step() reads, in view pixels; gravity is view px per second squared

floorTop.description: view y of the floor's top edge; read by the cell, not by the sim

art.description: loose on purpose - see the file description. Extra keys are allowed here and inside every band and prop.
